changelog:
Casting keeps working with the new PerchTV, and series follow your settings.

WHAT CHANGED

- When you cast to PerchTV, the phone now tells the television which player name to use for each stream. Some providers only answer this app's player name; until now the television borrowed it, and the next PerchTV no longer does. Update the phone before the television, and every channel that plays on the phone keeps playing on the television.
- A series' episode list now follows Safe mode and your content languages, the same as every other list in the app.
- The guide no longer keeps the same programme twice. A one-time tidy-up on the first start removes the duplicates the guide had gathered.
- Slow storage operations are now timed and logged too, not only slow searches, which makes a sluggish phone easier to diagnose.

WHAT STAYS THE SAME

- Everything from 0.5.7: scheduled recording from Diagnostics, the television's questions, Retry now on a failed recording.

NOT YET

- Recording from the guide and a recordings list in the app: for now the Diagnostics row is the way to start one.
